summary: Run 39845591542 of wasm-custody-pilot.yml was the single dispatch admitted by FS-GG/.github#4710 comment 6349235037, at cbfdb04 (artifact zip sha256 ef9000f4..., 101 files). Independent acceptance (comment 6350233291): ACCEPTED, and the custody pilot phase is complete. The bounded WebKit apt step completed: update and install both exited 0 with no timeout; 172 packages were added (exactly apt's NEW list), 4 GLib packages upgraded and none removed; all 51 pinned Playwright 1.63.0 ubuntu24.04 webkit packages are present; all 176 fetches came from the Azure mirror; and no apt or dpkg process remained. Unit properties matched the admission and all 20 groups were contained. Established across runs 1-3 on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 with owner d846dbe1: Chromium 1243 and Firefox 1543 on three runner builds (20261021.345.10, 20261018.339.1, 20261012.334.1), and WebKit 2359 on build 20261012.334.1 with the recorded host packages (a stock runner lacks them). For each: clean stock shutdown with the Playwright webServer under require-empty, cgroup.kill deadline retirement, and owner-performed survivor retirement. For WebKit 26.6 this covers the pw_run.sh (bash) -> MiniBrowser -> WPENetworkProcess/WPEWebProcess chain. Gaps: forced cases show observed members, not those alive at the deadline; per-browser argv is not recorded; WebKit was tested on one build and one package set; survivors were held by a live Playwright holder, so a truly orphaned browser is untested. Installed C and the 27-case journey are separate admissions.
title: Final WASM custody pilot run qualified all three families; custody pilot phase complete
